d:
Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO in a dramatic reversal, sending Asian chipmakers higher and reviving the AI trade. Huang says he intends to be a better chief executive the second time around, while his return keeps national-security questions in focus ahead of expected Senate testimony next week.
Ryan Zurrer of Dialectic says bringing Huang back does not end the scrutiny around Nvidia, arguing the board underestimated the level of support for him. Trump’s push for Huang’s return is also helping put a floor under sentiment toward the broader AI trade.
